statement_after:
## Example

Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $A\hookrightarrow B$ be an injective finite local map of nonzero Noetherian local rings, with $A$ regular. Then $B$ is Cohen–Macaulay if and only if it is free as an $A$-module.
